name: CL-RAG Multilingual Technical Paraphrase Retrieval Benchmark

documents.content: Fault tolerance guarantees high availability in distributed architectures by allowing systems to continue operating properly when component failures occur.
A load balancer distributes incoming network traffic across multiple backend servers to prevent overload and optimize resource utilization.
A circuit breaker monitors downstream services and isolates cascading failures automatically by tripping when error rates exceed safe thresholds.
Eventual consistency guarantees that all distributed database replicas will converge to the same value over time in the absence of new updates.
Horizontal scaling involves adding more compute instances or worker nodes to a distributed system cluster to manage growing traffic loads.
Container orchestration automates the deployment, scaling, health checking, and networking of microservice application containers.
Rate limiting caps the number of requests a client can transmit within a time window to prevent denial-of-service abuse and resource exhaustion.
A service mesh provides dedicated infrastructure with sidecar proxies to manage service-to-service communication, security encryption, and observability.
Idempotency ensures that performing the same API operation multiple times produces identical state without unintended side effects or duplicated actions.
Cache invalidation removes or updates stale data from temporary memory caches as soon as the source database is modified.
Positive end-expiratory pressure maintains positive pressure in the lungs at the end of expiration to prevent alveolar collapse during mechanical ventilation.
Tidal volume is the volume of gas moved into or out of the lungs during a single respiratory cycle under mechanical ventilation.
Pulse oximetry continuously and noninvasively measures oxygen saturation in arterial blood using spectrophotometric light absorption.
Biocompatibility assesses the ability of an implanted biomaterial to perform its function without causing toxic, allergic, or immunological rejection in living tissue.
Hemodialysis purifies the blood using an extracorporeal dialyzer filter to eliminate metabolic waste and excess fluid when kidneys fail.
Mechanical ventilation is life support that assists or replaces spontaneous breathing in respiratory failure using an automated pressure-controlled device.
An electrocardiogram records electrical potentials generated by heart muscle depolarization and repolarization through skin electrodes.
Arterial blood pressure measures the hydrodynamic force exerted by circulating blood on arterial vessel walls during cardiac contraction and relaxation.
Catheter ablation delivers radiofrequency or cryo energy to scar microscopic heart tissue that causes abnormal cardiac electrical rhythms.
Defibrillation applies a therapeutic dose of electrical current to the heart to depolarize myocardial tissue and restore normal sinus rhythm.
